company_profile: Abbott is a global healthcare company; its Diabetes Care site in Sligo makes diabetes technology and is building a Digital, Data & AI team.
title: Senior Data Scientist
summary: Senior Data Scientist with 8+ years delivering machine learning, predictive analytics and AI solutions into production, much of it on healthcare data, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Builds statistical and predictive models, anomaly detection and forecasting with Python, SQL and Databricks, and GenAI solutions with LLMs and RAG, validated through automated evaluation and monitoring. Works with stakeholders to turn business challenges into measurable outcomes and clear recommendations. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Manufacturing Quality Deviation Predictor
bullets: Built a LightGBM model that flagged likely batch quality deviations in medical device manufacturing from process and test data, with feature-level explanations for quality reviewers.
Validated the model on held-out batches with documented assumptions and limitations, tracked versions in MLflow on Databricks, and shared risk scores with stakeholders in Power BI.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Data Scientist role with the Digital, Data & AI team at Abbott Diabetes Care. Much of my data science work has sat close to healthcare data, from medical-audit reporting pipelines and plan recommendations to production AI at United Health Group, and it taught me that a model only matters once people trust it enough to act on it.

Building data capabilities from the ground up at a site that makes diabetes technology is work with a clear line to patients, and that is what draws me to it. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Sligo together and settle there long term, so a role built for the long run suits us both.

I would bring predictive analytics that reaches production. At Viavi I deployed an SLA breach prediction model with LightGBM, FastAPI and MLflow that reduced downtime by 67%, and ran anomaly detection and forecasting on 15+ KPIs across 500+ network devices. At United Health Group I built evaluation pipelines with LLM evaluators that cut human review by 43%.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. Working with teachers has made me careful about validation and plain about limitations, which matters just as much in a regulated setting. I would welcome a conversation about the role.
